iDrive: control over your driving comfort.
Whether you’re commuting or touring, you want to be totally comfortable, informed, and entertained by your favorite songs.
Welcome to the next-generation iDrive, a new benchmark in automotive technology. Included with the Navigation system
in the BMW 5 Series, this new iDrive offers intuitive, ergonomic control within easy reach on the center console.
The system places a wide variety of entertainment and communication options at your fi ngertips. Using the iDrive Controller, simply
tilt, rotate, push and click your way through any series of commands. New buttons, located above the Controller wheel, let you
directly access the four main menu choices: CD Player, Radio, Telephone and Navigation. Six programmable memory keys on the
dash allow you to store the settings of your choice, from preferred radio stations to frequently dialed phone numbers (if so equipped).
